verdict.rationale: Solid's README says that with Resources you can use server-loaded data like any other piece of state and build a responsive UI with Suspense and concurrent rendering (solid-gh-3). Suspense is also listed as a built-in framework feature (solid-gh-11), so the story's core is delivered first-party. One user's general advice to avoid Suspense (solid-comm-17) cites no concrete failure, so it lowers confidence but does not create a dispute. Missing for 10: in-depth documentation of the resource API (loading/error states, refetching), and independent or hands-on corroboration that resource and Suspense loading UIs work well in practice.
